title.ja: 友だちを家に招待する
title.en: Having a friend over for dinner

summary.ja: 家に来た友だちを迎えて、靴や飲み物のことを伝え、一緒に餃子を作る。
summary.en: Welcome a friend into your home, offer a drink and make gyoza together.

setting: The host's small apartment in Tokyo on a Saturday evening. They have invited a friend from abroad over for dinner, and the plan is to make gyoza together.

roles.persona: A Japanese person who has invited a friend home for dinner.

levels.tutor: You are Max, the host's friend from abroad, visiting their home for the first time. Open by ringing the doorbell and saying hi when the door opens; wait for them to invite you in. Speak slowly, in short simple sentences. When asked to take off your shoes, say "Oh, okay!" and do it. When offered a drink, ask for tea. Ask what's for dinner.

hints: あいさつして、中に入ってもらいましょう
Hi, welcome! Please …
Hi, welcome! Please come in.

title.en: Ask them to take off their shoes

hints: 靴を脱いでもらい、スリッパを出しましょう
Could you take off …? Here are …
Could you take off your shoes? Here are some slippers.
飲み物をすすめましょう
Would you like something …?
Would you like something to drink?

title.ja: 今夜のメニューを伝える

hints: 今夜は一緒に餃子を作ると伝えましょう
Tonight we're making …
Tonight we're making gyoza together!

levels.tutor: You are Max, the host's friend from abroad, speaking at natural pace. Open by ringing the doorbell, saying hi and handing over a box of cookies as a small gift; wait for them to welcome you. Ask if you should take your shoes off. You've never made gyoza before, so ask how to make them.

title.ja: 迎えておみやげのお礼を言う

hints: 迎えて、おみやげのお礼を言いましょう
Welcome! Thanks so much for …!
Welcome! Thanks so much for the cookies!

title.ja: 靴とスリッパのことを説明する

hints: 家では靴を脱ぐことと、スリッパのことを説明しましょう
In Japan, we take off … Please use …
In Japan, we take off our shoes inside. Please use these slippers.

title.ja: くつろいでもらい、飲み物をすすめる

hints: くつろいでと言って、飲み物をすすめましょう
Make yourself at home. Can I get you …?
Make yourself at home. Can I get you a drink?

title.ja: 餃子の包み方を説明する

hints: 餃子の包み方を説明しましょう
Put a little … in the middle, then …
Put a little filling in the middle, then fold it like this.

levels.tutor: You are Max, the host's friend from abroad, chatty and speaking at natural speed. Open by ringing the doorbell, saying hi and apologising for being ten minutes late; wait for them to welcome you. Ask what the plan is for dinner. When they show you how to wrap gyoza, try it and say it's your first time making gyoza.

title.ja: 気にしないでと迎える

hints: 遅れたことは気にしないでと伝えて、迎えましょう
Don't worry about it! Come in and …
Don't worry about it! Come in and make yourself at home.

title.ja: 今夜の予定を説明する

hints: 一緒に餃子を作ることと、具の中身を説明しましょう
I thought we could … together. The filling is …
I thought we could make gyoza together. The filling is pork and cabbage.

title.en: Show them how to wrap gyoza

hints: 包み方を説明しましょう
Just put a spoonful in the middle, then …
Just put a spoonful in the middle, then fold and press the edges.
上手にできたとほめましょう
Wow, yours look …! Are you sure …?
Wow, yours look great! Are you sure it's your first time?

twist.tutor: Look a little embarrassed and say politely that you don't eat pork; you're sorry you didn't mention it earlier. Accept any sensible solution warmly.

title.ja: 食べられないものに対応する

hints: 気にしないでと伝えて、野菜だけの餃子を提案しましょう
No problem. I'll make yours with … and …
No problem. I'll make yours with vegetables and cook them first.

roles.persona: Max, a friend from abroad visiting the host's home for the first time.

levels.tutor: You are Mai, who has invited the student home for dinner. Speak slowly, in short simple sentences. Open by opening the door and saying "Hi, welcome!" Ask them to take off their shoes, and offer them tea or juice.

hints: 招待してくれたお礼を言いましょう
Thank you for …!
Thank you for inviting me!
おみやげを渡しましょう
This is for you. It's …
This is for you. It's some cookies.
飲みたいものを伝えましょう
Could I have …, please?
Could I have some tea, please?

levels.tutor: You are Mai, who has invited the student home for dinner, speaking at natural pace. Open by opening the door and welcoming them in. When asked about shoes, say yes and give them slippers. Tonight you're making gyoza together; when asked, show them how to fold them.

title.ja: 一言そえておみやげを渡す
title.en: Give your gift with a few words

hints: 一言そえて、おみやげを渡しましょう
I brought you … I hope you …
I brought you some cookies. I hope you like them.
ここで靴を脱ぐか聞きましょう
Should I take off …?
Should I take off my shoes here?
何か手伝えるか聞きましょう
Can I help …?
Can I help with anything?
餃子の包み方を聞きましょう
How do you …?
How do you fold the gyoza?

levels.tutor: You are Mai, who has invited the student home for dinner, speaking at natural speed. Open by opening the door and saying hi; they are ten minutes late, and when they apologise, tell them not to worry. Tonight you're making gyoza with a pork and cabbage filling; tell them the plan once they're inside. You also have plenty of vegetables, so if they say they don't eat pork, happily offer to make theirs with vegetables only and cook them first.

hints: 遅れたことを、理由をそえて謝りましょう
Sorry I'm … The train …
Sorry I'm late. The train was delayed.

title.ja: 食べられないものを伝える

hints: 豚肉を食べないことを、ていねいに伝えましょう
I'm sorry, I should have told you earlier, but I don't …
I'm sorry, I should have told you earlier, but I don't eat pork.

title.en: Thank them for changing the dish

hints: 気づかいにお礼を言いましょう
Thank you so much. That's really …
Thank you so much. That's really kind of you.
餃子をほめましょう
These are …! You should …
These are delicious! You should open a restaurant.
